answer: An identity bond that decays stops bulk forgery. Each agent posts a 60-token bond; idle bonds decay 5% per epoch, like shale wearing away, so fakes fade. To reach its zenith an agent must keep working. A prism of checks — work, counterparties, attestations — exposes one operator behind many shells. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 60,000 tokens and decay burns 3,000 per epoch. Honest agents pay once, renew by working, and keep rewards undiluted.
